scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of the default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false) and not the author's working copy. Collection of learning scripts and Jupyter notebooks (notebook code cells treated as Python). Not scanned in depth: embedded base64 image outputs in notebooks, binary SQLite files (flights.db, example.db, beautiful_soup/example.db, example2.db) and the 18,500-row electricity usage CSV beyond its header. The real-looking email address in mantis_bak.py line 60 is deliberately not reproduced. Several committed files are non-secret but notable: .idea/ IDE files, geckodriver.log, SQLite .db files.

gitignore_gaps: no exclusion for *.pem / *.key / credentials.json style files
no exclusion for *.db SQLite files (4 committed)
no exclusion for .idea/ (IDE files committed) or __pycache__/venv directories

findings: No requirements.txt, pyproject.toml or Pipfile although code imports third-party packages (selenium, bs4/beautifulsoup4, pandas in notebooks); dependencies are undeclared.
Selenium scripts use find_element_by_id style calls removed in current Selenium releases (not verified against an installed version).

hardcoded_secrets_in_source.note: Real-looking login password for a MantisHub account (se.mantishub.io) committed in a tracked file, together with a real-looking email address on line 60 (not reproduced here).
Tutorial placeholder copied from a Selenium example (username 'me').

entry_points.framework: plain python scripts (web scraping with bs4/urllib)

sql_injection_risk.reason: INSERT uses ? placeholders; remaining execute() calls use literal SQL strings.
notebook cells connect to flights.db; no string-built SQL found

external_apis.host: www.facebook.com / www.google.com / www.yahoo.com / login.live.com (Selenium tutorial examples)

file_system_access.detail: sets Firefox download directory to /home/jcz/github/LearningPy (hardcoded home path) for a backup download

sensitive_data_indicators.field_or_variable: utility electricity usage records with account/meter-style identifiers (USE2023-08_12_2025.csv, 18,527 rows)

office_and_collaboration_sources.location_or_host: beautiful_soup/index.csv (CSV write code is commented out in beautiful.py)

what_this_app_can_do: Automates a browser login (Selenium/Firefox) to a MantisHub site and downloads a backup, using a username and password typed into the script.
Scrapes stock index quotes from public web pages and stores them in a local SQLite database.
Analyzes an electricity usage CSV in a notebook and runs assorted Python learning exercises (strings, dicts, water-chemistry calculator, birthday and age scripts).

data_sources_touched.source: Bloomberg and a bare-IP quote page (scraped)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Run locally by whoever executes the scripts; no server, no listening ports. The repository (public GitHub remote) exposes the committed credential and data files to anyone who can read it.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: mantis_bak.py contains a real-looking MantisHub email and password committed to git.
Utility usage CSV with account/meter-style identifiers and four SQLite databases are committed.
Scripts automate logins to third-party sites (Facebook, Microsoft, MantisHub) via Selenium.

top_findings: Hardcoded real-looking MantisHub password (and email) in mantis_bak.py
Placeholder passwords in Selenium tutorial scripts (low)
